servicesPage.intro: At Wood Furniture YP, we offer a full range of custom carpentry services in Dallas, TX. From furniture to cabinetry, we bring your ideas to life with expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.shortDescription: Bespoke tables, chairs, beds, and more built to your specifications.
services.longDescription: We design and build custom furniture that fits your space and style. Using premium hardwoods and modern techniques, we create pieces that are both functional and beautiful.
benefits: Tailored to your exact dimensions and design
Choice of wood species, finish, and hardware
Built with traditional joinery for longevity

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We meet with you to understand your needs, style, and budget.

process.title: Design & Quote
process.description: We create a detailed design and provide a transparent quote.

process.title: Build & Install
process.description: We craft your piece in our workshop and deliver it to your home.

faqs.question: What types of wood do you use?
faqs.answer: We work with oak, maple, cherry, walnut, and more. We can also source exotic woods upon request.

faqs.question: How long does a custom furniture project take?
faqs.answer: Typical projects take 2-4 weeks depending on complexity. We'll provide a timeline during consultation.

services.title: Kitchen Cabinets
services.shortDescription: Custom kitchen cabinets that combine style and storage.
services.longDescription: Upgrade your kitchen with custom cabinets designed to maximize space and reflect your taste. We offer a variety of styles, from modern to traditional, with soft-close hardware and durable finishes.

process.title: Design Consultation
process.description: We measure your kitchen and discuss your storage needs and style preferences.

process.title: Custom Fabrication
process.description: Our team builds your cabinets in our shop using precision tools.

process.title: Professional Installation
process.description: We install your cabinets, ensuring perfect fit and alignment.

faqs.question: Do you offer refacing services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can reface existing cabinets with new doors, drawers, and hardware for a fraction of the cost of replacement.

faqs.question: What is the typical timeline for kitchen cabinets?
faqs.answer: Most kitchen cabinet projects take 4-6 weeks from design to installation.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.shortDescription: Custom bathroom vanities that blend functionality and elegance.
services.longDescription: Create a spa-like bathroom with a custom vanity. We design and build vanities with your choice of wood, countertops, and sinks, tailored to your bathroom's layout.
benefits: Choice of single or double sinks

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We discuss your bathroom layout, storage needs, and design preferences.

process.title: Design & Material Selection
process.description: We create a design and help you choose wood, finish, and countertop.

process.title: Fabrication & Installation
process.description: We build and install your vanity, including plumbing connections.

faqs.question: Can you match existing bathroom fixtures?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can match stains and paints to your existing fixtures for a cohesive look.

faqs.question: Do you supply countertops?
faqs.answer: We can source quartz, granite, marble, or solid surface countertops to complete your vanity.

services.title: Built-in Shelving & Cabinets
services.shortDescription: Custom built-ins that add character and storage to any room.
services.longDescription: Maximize your space with custom built-in shelving, bookcases, entertainment centers, and more. Designed to fit your room perfectly, our built-ins add both function and beauty.
benefits: Custom fit to your wall dimensions

process.title: Site Visit & Design
process.description: We measure the space and design a built-in that complements your room.

process.title: Craftsmanship
process.description: We build your built-in in our workshop for precision.

process.title: Installation & Finish
process.description: We install and finish the built-in, matching your trim and paint.

faqs.question: Can you match my existing trim and molding?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We can replicate existing profiles and paint colors for a seamless look.

faqs.question: How long does a built-in project take?
faqs.answer: Most built-ins take 2-3 weeks from design to completion.

about.headline: Dallas's Premier Custom Carpenter
about.mission: To provide exceptional custom woodwork that enhances homes and lives, using traditional craftsmanship and modern techniques.
story: Wood Furniture YP was founded in 2010 by master carpenter John P. with a passion for creating beautiful, functional woodwork. What started as a small workshop has grown into a full-service carpentry business serving homeowners throughout Dallas. Our team combines decades of experience with a commitment to quality that shows in every project.

We believe that every piece of wood has potential, and every home deserves craftsmanship that stands the test of time. From custom furniture to kitchen remodels, we approach each project with the same dedication: listening to our clients, using the finest materials, and delivering results that exceed expectations.
